record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Determine conditions under which formal deformations of grading-restricted vertex algebras converge to analytic deformations, and generalize the deformation theory of grading-restricted vertex algebras to a deformation theory of genus-zero full conformal field theories.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.2. Find the conditions for the formal deformations of grading- restricted vertex algebras to converge to analytic deformations. Generalize the de- formation theory of grading-restricted vertex algebras to a deformation theory of genus-zero full conformal ﬁeld theories.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions:

A grading-restricted vertex algebra is a ℤ-graded vector space V = ⨁_{n∈ℤ} V_{(n)} with dim V_{(n)} < ∞ for all n and V_{(n)} = 0 for n sufficiently negative, equipped with a vertex operator map Y(·,x): V → (End V)[[x,x^{-1}]], a vacuum vector 𝟏 ∈ V_{(0)} and a conformal vector ω ∈ V_{(2)} satisfying the standard axioms (vacuum, creation, Jacobi identity, Virasoro relations with central charge c, and L(0)-grading v ∈ V_{(n)} ⇒ L(0)v = nv).

A formal deformation of V over ℂ[[t]] is a ℂ[[t]]-module structure V[[t]] together with a vertex operator Y_t(·,x) = Y(·,x) + ∑_{k≥1} t^k Y_k(·,x), with vacuum 𝟏 and a (possibly t-deformed) conformal vector, satisfying the vertex algebra axioms over ℂ[[t]]; equivalently, a Maurer–Cartan element in the deformation complex governed by Huang's cohomology theory of grading-restricted vertex algebras. The deformation is called analytic on a disk D ⊂ ℂ if for every v_1,…,v_n ∈ V and every choice of distinct points z_1,…,z_n in a suitable domain, the formal series defining the iterated/composed vertex operators

  ⟨v', Y_t(v_1,z_1) ⋯ Y_t(v_n,z_n) v⟩ ∈ ℂ[[t]][[z_i, z_i^{-1}, (z_i−z_j)^{-1}]]

are absolutely convergent for t ∈ D to multivalued analytic functions in (z_1,…,z_n) extending to rational functions away from the diagonals, with the convergent values defining a vertex algebra structure depending analytically on t.

A genus-zero full conformal field theory (in the sense of full nonchiral CFT on the Riemann sphere) consists of a ℂ-graded vector space H = ⨁_{(m,n)∈ℂ²} H_{(m,n)} together with correlation functions assigned to configurations of marked points on ℂ̂, satisfying conformal invariance, locality, operator product expansion, modular/duality and sewing axioms, in such a way that the chiral and antichiral halves carry commuting actions of vertex operator algebras V_L and V_R.

Problem. 

(a) Determine sufficient (and, if possible, necessary) conditions on a grading-restricted vertex algebra V and on the cocycle data of a formal deformation Y_t such that the formal deformation converges to an analytic deformation in the sense above on some open neighborhood of t = 0.

(b) Generalize the cohomological deformation theory of grading-restricted vertex algebras to a deformation theory of genus-zero full conformal field theories: define an appropriate deformation complex whose first cohomology classifies infinitesimal deformations of a genus-zero full CFT, whose second cohomology contains the obstructions, and formulate the analogous formal-to-analytic convergence problem in this setting.
artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator algebras and deformation theory of CFT
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (Huang's cohomology theory and its extensions to vertex superalgebras, and convergence results for analytic conformal blocks of C₂-cofinite VOAs) provide tools relevant to the problem, but the literature continues to list convergence of formal deformations to analytic deformations and the deformation theory of genus-zero full CFTs as open conjectures and problems. No general solution has been published.

status_evidence.title: A cohomology theory of supercommutative algebras and grading-restricted vertex superalgebras
status_evidence.snippet: generalizing Yi-Zhi Huang's cohomology theory of grading-restricted vertex algebras... capable of classifying full formal deformations of a large class of strongly generated vertex superalgebras
status_evidence.claim: Cohomological deformation theory of grading-restricted vertex (super)algebras is still being developed; convergence to analytic deformations not established in general.

status_evidence.title: Convergence in Conformal Field Theory
status_evidence.snippet: reviews some main convergence results, conjectures and problems... explains conjectures and problems on the convergence and analytic extensions...in the cohomology theory of vertex operator algebras
status_evidence.claim: Convergence problems in the cohomology/deformation theory of VOAs remain stated as conjectures and open problems.
